definitions.explanation: An educational system in which students earn credits by passing courses and graduate once they accumulate the required number, rather than advancing by fixed year-groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単位制|たんいせい}だ。
examples.english: This high school uses a credit system.

examples.japanese: {単位制|たんいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間割|じかんわり}→時間割：08552_jikanwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: At a credit-system school you build your own timetable.

examples.japanese: {単位制|たんいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえれば⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Under the credit system you can graduate once you have all the required credits.

notes:
Contrasts with the {学年制|がくねんせい} (year-group system), in which students are promoted by grade level. Common at universities and at credit-system high schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単位制|たんいせい}⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧: a credit-system high school
- {単位制|たんいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adopt a credit system
- ⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to earn credits
